items.title: Lemon Juice Does Not Cure COVID-19
items.snippet_en: The National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine states that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice does not destroy the coronavirus or prevent COVID-19. There is no scientific evidence to support these claims. While lemons contain vitamin C, it does not boost the immune system enough to protect against viral infections. The acidity of lemon juice does not kill the virus.

items.title: Can drinking or gargling with lemon juice or lemon water kill the coronavirus?
items.snippet_en: Cleveland Clinic states that drinking or gargling with lemon juice or lemon water does not kill the coronavirus. Experts have debunked these claims, emphasizing a lack of scientific evidence. The idea that the acidity of lemon juice can kill the virus in the body is incorrect, as the virus can survive in acidic environments.
